mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where FEDFUNDS increased by more than 0.25% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% within a month indicates a weakening labor market, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer spending and business investment decline.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where UNRATE increased by more than 0.5% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals a weakening demand environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings expectations adjust downward.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where GDPC1 declined over two consecutive quarters.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% within a month signals a strengthening supply side, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as economic growth prospects improve.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where INDPRO increased by more than 1% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low inflation environment, indicated by CPIAUCSL remaining below 2% for three consecutive months, signals a stable monetary policy, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors favor equities in a low-inflation, low-interest rate environment.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where CPIAUCSL remained below 2% for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in retail sales (RSAFS) by more than 1% within a month signals strengthening consumer demand, which historically correlates with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as market sentiment improves.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where RSAFS increased by more than 1% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) both show a negative trend over two consecutive months, it signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as economic concerns rise.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE and PAYEMS both decline over 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where both UNRATE and PAYEMS declined over two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% within a month, coupled with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.2%, signals a strengthening demand environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer confidence and economic activity improve.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increase > 5% and UNRATE decrease > 0.2% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where HOUST increased by more than 5% and UNRATE decreased by more than 0.2% within a month.
